stories.title: Mercedes Moné responds to Ric Flair calling Charlotte Flair the female GOAT
stories.tldr: Ric Flair recently took to Instagram to declare his daughter Charlotte Flair the greatest female wrestler of all time while sharing a photo collage that also featured Trish Stratus, AJ Lee, Stephanie McMahon, and Mercedes Mone. Mone, who was included in the collage from her days as Sasha Banks, quickly fired back at the Nature Boy in the comments section. Playfully threatening the WWE Hall of Famer, Mone challenged his bold claim by asking if he wanted to get his ass kicked while throwing in his signature woooo.

stories.title: Paige (Saraya) calls out weird airport scalper behavior
stories.tldr: Saraya, formerly known as Paige, recently called out an aggressive airport scalper who purchased a plane ticket just to ambush her at a connecting flight gate with dozens of photos to sign. The wrestling star condemned the tactic as invasive behavior, joining a growing list of talent speaking out against merchandise resellers at travel hubs. The incident highlights an increasing trend where scalpers buy tickets to bypass security and exploit wrestlers during their travels.

stories.title: AEW Brawl In The Ballpark special event streaming details
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling is streaming its special event, Brawl In The Ballpark, tonight at 6 pm ET worldwide and ad-free via the MyAEW platform. The broadcast features the action from the July 10, 2026, live event hosted by the Minnesota Twins at Target Field in Minneapolis. Fans can tune in to hear commentary from Ian Riccaboni and Tony Schiavone calling matches such as Orange Cassidy versus Wheeler Yuta and The Hurt Syndicate versus Shane Taylor Promotions.

stories.title: AEW production and entrance limitations for All In London at Wembley Stadium
stories.tldr: AEW is gearing up for its major All In London pay-per-view event at Wembley Stadium on Sunday, August 30, 2026, featuring extravagant entrances for top talent. Despite plans for impressive displays from stars like Mercedes Mone, Will Ospreay, and Kenny Omega, the company will face strict limitations on pyrotechnics. This restriction comes in the wake of a wildfire risk controversy at the stadium involving a recent concert held during a severe UK government weather alert. Local authorities have since sought strict assurances from venue officials regarding safety and fire management.

stories.title: Deonna Purrazzo praises Steph De Lander following ROH Death Before Dishonor match
stories.tldr: Following her successful ROH Women's Pure Title defense at ROH Death Before Dishonor, Deonna Purrazzo expressed high praise for her opponent, Steph De Lander. During the post-show media scrum, Purrazzo highlighted De Lander's decision to bet on herself by leaving her previous company and praised her resilience following neck surgery. Purrazzo emphasized her passion for supporting women in wrestling and stated she was honored to introduce De Lander's talents to the Ring of Honor audience.

stories.title: Reason behind AEW Dynamite's lengthy television overruns revealed
stories.tldr: Recent AEW Dynamite broadcasts have frequently run well past their scheduled ending times, sparking curiosity and backstage debate. According to reports, network partner Warner Bros. Discovery specifically requests these extended overruns to secure extra programming content. While some talent and staff within AEW have expressed frustration over the uncompensated extra time and declining viewership at the end of the show, Tony Khan continues to accommodate the network. Ultimately, keeping WBD happy is a strategic move for AEW as they look toward the network's 2028 option on their television deal.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett shares career advice for his younger self
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Jeff Jarrett recently reflected on what wisdom he would share with his younger self during an episode of his My World podcast. Prompted by a recent interview question, Jarrett emphasized the importance of embracing love and appreciating life struggles. Drawing from a lifetime of personal and professional trials, including founding TNA, personal loss, and recovery, the 59-year-old wrestling star noted that life valleys are essential for creating mountaintops.

stories.title: Dax Harwood credits WWE NXT match for starting FTR's tag team momentum
stories.tldr: While currently on a wrestling hiatus, AEW star Dax Harwood reflected on his career and pinpointed a specific 2016 match as the catalyst for FTR's success. He credited their NXT TakeOver: Dallas clash against American Alpha for truly establishing them on the brand. Harwood also highlighted his enduring mutual respect and ongoing relationship with Chad Gable.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live discusses AEW, ROH title reigns, and Bayley
stories.tldr: The latest episode of Wrestling Observer Live dives into the challenges facing All Elite Wrestling, including a lackluster crowd at Collision and the slow build toward the upcoming All In pay-per-view. The discussion also explores the future of midcard talent like Daniel Garcia amidst expected new roster signings and argues for shorter championship reigns in Ring of Honor. Additionally, the show touches on Bayley's recent career decisions, previews TNA Lockdown, and covers various personal and pop culture topics.

stories.title: Former WWE stars rumored to debut in AEW All In Casino Gauntlet Match
stories.tldr: AEW's upcoming All In pay-per-view features the Casino Gauntlet Match, which serves as an ideal platform for major surprise debuts. With several notable names recently leaving WWE, analysts are speculating on who might enter the match as a surprise entrant. Potential candidates include top-tier free agents like Ilja Dragunov and Sheamus, legacy names like Davey Boy Smith Jr, and independent standouts such as Joseph Sawyer and Malakai Black.

stories.title: MJF appearance and additional matches announced for AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: MJF will appear live on the upcoming episode of AEW Dynamite in Glasgow following his translator's message to Andrade last week. AEW National Champion Andrade El Idolo is also scheduled to speak on the show. These developments build toward their number one and number two entry spots in the Casino Gauntlet match at AEW All In.

stories.title: Matt Cardona suffers torn tricep injury at WWE Main Event taping
stories.tldr: WWE star Matt Cardona has announced that he suffered a torn tricep during a match against Kit Wilson at a Main Event taping in Toronto. Despite the injury, Cardona remains determined, noting on social media that he still hit the gym to work on his legs and is not finished yet. The setback adds to a rough month for the Cardona household, coming shortly after his wife, Chelsea Green, suffered a broken orbital bone. How WWE will handle his absence and the exact recovery timeline remain unclear as of this writing.

stories.title: ESPN Unlimited increases subscription prices affecting WWE PLE viewers
stories.tldr: ESPN has announced a price increase for its streaming tiers, directly impacting WWE fans who rely on the platform to watch Premium Live Events. Starting September 17, the monthly ESPN Unlimited subscription will rise from $29.99 to $31.99, while the annual plan will increase from $299.99 to $319.99. Additionally, the lower-tier ESPN Select service is also seeing price bumps for both monthly and annual options. This latest adjustment makes one of the most expensive major sports streaming packages even costlier for professional wrestling viewers.

stories.title: Fabian Aichner opens up about WWE release following dropped character vignettes
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Fabian Aichner recently opened up on Busted Open Radio about the emotional roller coaster of his sudden release following a series of dropped return vignettes as Giovanni Vinci. Aichner recalled receiving the unexpected phone call by his pool just as he thought his career-defining moment was finally arriving. After wrestling his final WWE match in December 2025 and briefly stepping away from the industry to experience life without wrestling, he has since successfully resurfaced in TNA as of May 2026.

stories.title: Joe Hendry responds to negative fan reaction over WWE Raw segment with Danhausen
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry recently addressed the significant online criticism surrounding his and Danhausen's concert segment on WWE Raw last July. Appearing on Busted Open, Hendry opened up about the backlash, admitting that missing the mark can be painful when he strives so hard to give fans value. He emphasized his total commitment to WWE, detailing how he moved to Orlando to immerse himself in NXT classes and local shows. Looking past the negative reception, Hendry remains focused on working hard, learning from the highest level of professional wrestling, and continuing to deliver his absolute best to the audience.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show recaps SmackDown and Collision
stories.tldr: The latest episode of the Bryan and Vinny Show delivers a comprehensive recap of the week in professional wrestling. Hosts break down the highlights from Friday Night SmackDown, which featured a stellar main event between CM Punk and Kevin Owens. The review also covers Saturday Collision featuring Continental Cup matches and ongoing build toward Wembley. Additionally, the hosts strongly urge listeners to seek out and watch the standout match between Nick Wayne and Bandido.

stories.title: Fan hits WWE-style dropkick during upper deck brawl at White Sox game
stories.tldr: During a White Sox versus Mets game, a massive brawl erupted in the upper deck involving multiple fans throwing punches and shoves. Escalating the chaos, one individual launched a full-on wrestling-style dropkick that sent another fan crashing backward through the rows. Security eventually restored order, though the viral ringside-style incident overshadowed the White Sox dramatic ninth-inning walk-off victory on the field.

stories.title: Booker T recalls concerns over fan acceptance of a Black World Champion
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently reflected on winning his first WCW World Heavyweight Championship at Bash at the Beach in 2000. He admitted he was deeply worried about whether wrestling fans would accept a Black man in that top role, especially considering the lack of sustained main event pushes for predecessors like Ron Simmons. Beyond fan reception, Booker T also noted that navigating the intense backstage politics and the good old boy system of that era presented major hurdles. Despite these apprehensions, he went on to capture the WCW World Heavyweight Championship multiple times, eventually becoming the final wrestler to hold the title before the company was sold to WWE.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam discusses broken WWE promises during his run
stories.tldr: Rob Van Dam recently opened up about his early WWE run, revealing that constant backstage disappointment led him to stop believing management's plans. Despite working immediately with top stars like The Rock and Chris Jericho, RVD felt that unfulfilled promises outweighed his actual television success. He noted that broken commitments, such as suffering a frustrating loss to Luther Reigns during a major WWE trip to Japan, left a lasting negative impression. Consequently, RVD remembers the dashed expectations more vividly than historic victories over legends like Kurt Angle and The Rock.

stories.title: Report details high WWE NXT contracts matching main-roster money
stories.tldr: Recent reports reveal that select WWE NXT talent are already earning main-roster level money before ever moving to Raw or SmackDown. Major names like Jordynne Grace, Joe Hendry, and potentially Ricky Starks and Ethan Page have signed deals exceeding the $350,000 main-roster minimum. Because these wrestlers already command high salaries to add value for the CW Network, WWE does not automatically issue new contracts or reset their timelines upon a main-roster call-up.

stories.title: Hulk Hogan reflects on iconic rivalry and betrayal by Andre the Giant
stories.tldr: Hulk Hogan reflects on one of the most iconic rivalries in professional wrestling history, focusing on the historic betrayal by Andre the Giant. In a special feature from the WWE Vault, the legendary champion tells all about the events leading up to their legendary clash. The in-depth look explores the deep emotions and immense impact of Andre turning his back on his longtime friend. This retrospective provides fans with a behind the scenes perspective on a defining moment in sports entertainment.

stories.title: WWE star debuts new hair look following championship loss and heel turn teases
stories.tldr: Following a recent loss of the Women’s United States Championship on SmackDown due to miscommunication with Chelsea Green, WWE star Tiffany Stratton has debuted a striking new pink hair look on TikTok. The championship defeat and subsequent tension have sparked strong speculation of an impending heel turn against Green, mirroring the villainous persona that defined her successful rise in NXT and her early main roster days. Fans and analysts believe this character shift could reignite her momentum and position her for a major championship pursuit upon Rhea Ripley's eventual return from injury.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff discusses struggling with 'What?' chants upon entering WWE
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff recently discussed on his podcast how difficult it was to handle the famous What chants when he first arrived in WWE as an on-screen authority figure. He noted that the chants, popularized by Stone Cold Steve Austin, were weaponized by fans to throw performers off their game during promos. Bischoff viewed the phenomenon as an early sign of crowds realizing their immense power to influence live television. Even Steve Austin has reportedly felt some guilt over how the chant has endured and complicated his legacy.

stories.title: Natalya reflects on 1997 Canadian Stampede ahead of WWE return to Calgary
stories.tldr: Ahead of WWE returning to Calgary for a house show at the Saddledome, Natalya shared a nostalgic throwback to the historic 1997 In Your House: Canadian Stampede pay-per-view. In her social media post, the veteran wrestler reflected on being just 15 years old when she joined the Hart Foundation celebration in the ring, marking the last time her legendary family was all together in a WWE ring. Natalya expressed her deep gratitude for returning to the exact same venue where her journey began, coinciding with WWE's current multi-city Canadian tour.

stories.title: WWE star claims wrestling fans would 'suck as writers'
stories.tldr: WWE star Angel Garza recently criticized fans on social media after they backlash over a recent angle involving Los Perros del Mal in AAA. Garza argued that viewers would make terrible writers because they are too impatient and want to rush straight to the climax of a story in a single show. The controversy stems from Bronco Nima being swiftly booted from the faction after losing to Penta, leaving an open spot in the group. Speculation is now growing that former World Heavyweight Champion Damian Priest could soon fill the vacancy following his recent AAA debut.

stories.title: Natalya discusses plans for opening a Hart Family Dungeon training school
stories.tldr: WWE star Natalya recently discussed the potential of eventually opening the legendary Hart Family Dungeon training school to the general public. Currently, the modern iteration of the school operates strictly on an invite-only basis and is led by Natalya and her husband, TJ Wilson. Natalya emphasized that they do not charge trainees, choosing instead to personally fund the facility while prioritizing absolute dedication and passion for the professional wrestling business.

stories.title: Status update on Johnny Gargano amid WWE absence and rumors
stories.tldr: Johnny Gargano has not wrestled in WWE since the April 17, 2026 edition of SmackDown, leading to fan speculation about his status when some noticed his Twitter bio did not mention the company. However, wrestling sources clarified that Gargano has not had WWE in his bio for years and remains firmly on the internal roster. Rumors were further fueled by former creative team member Road Dogg Brian James, who posted a cryptic message on Facebook about changing times and Gargano's association with Triple H.

stories.title: Backstage producers revealed for recent WWE Raw episode
stories.tldr: WWE recently hosted an action-packed episode of Monday Night RAW in Buffalo, New York, featuring major stars, tournament action, and championship matches. Internal reports have now revealed the backstage producers responsible for orchestrating each segment and bout on the card. The broadcast, which carried the internal title Delivered, highlighted top talent across multiple divisions including heavy-hitting faction confrontations.

stories.title: Tyson Kidd reflects on transitioning from WWE wrestler to backstage producer
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Tyson Kidd recently reflected on his transition from an in-ring competitor to a backstage producer following his career-ending injury in 2015. Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Kidd shared that his producer role is even more fulfilling than his wrestling career, despite the challenge of having to coach talent entirely verbally rather than showing them in the ring. Nic Nemeth also appeared on the show to praise Kidd for bringing fresh ideas and benefiting the entire roster during his early days behind the scenes. Kidd credited Nemeth, Seth Rollins, and Finn Balor for helping him navigate the unguided transition into his new backstage role.

stories.title: Amazing Red recalls 2005 WWE dark match against CM Punk
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance on Chris Van Vliet Insight, Amazing Red reflected on his lone 2005 WWE dark match against CM Punk, which served as a crucial tryout for Punk under the supervision of agent Ricky Steamboat. Red faced immense pressure backstage after learning it was potentially Punk's last chance to get signed, while also being told he could not use his signature high-flying moves. The match itself suffered from botches and miscommunication, leading to a blunt backstage critique from John Laurinaitis about Red looking blown up. Although Red never got to thank Punk that night due to Punk walking away, he has since moved past the bitter experience.

stories.title: Lainey Reid describes bittersweet feeling regarding her WWE NXT call-up
stories.tldr: Lainey Reid recently discussed the bittersweet nature of her rapid WWE main roster call-up to SmackDown alongside Fallon Henley and Jacy Jayne. Although reaching the main roster is the ultimate goal for developmental talent, Reid felt she missed out on accomplishing several personal ambitions in NXT due to the timing. However, she has embraced a fresh mindset, viewing the transition as an opportunity to introduce herself to a broader audience without prior expectations.

stories.title: Matt Hardy recalls Vince McMahon scrapping Bray Wyatt match plans late at night
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy recently revealed that Vince McMahon late at night scrapped his elaborate cinematic match plans against the late Bray Wyatt in 2018. Hardy had envisioned a high-risk spot involving a tree, stacked tables, and a supernatural appearance by the ghost of Brother Nero. However, after hours of waiting, production finally heard back from McMahon at 2 a.m. with orders to halt the cinematic stunts and pivot to a live finish instead.

stories.title: Seth Rollins' expected plans for WWE return following SummerSlam
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins has been off WWE television since losing to Roman Reigns at SummerSlam 2026 Night Two, leaving creative with a blank slate for his eventual return. Potential directions for the former Shield member include entering the Money in the Bank ladder match to chase a historic back-to-back briefcase win or assisting Oba Femi against The Vision. Other options involve a brand switch to SmackDown for fresh matchups or reigniting past rivalries with stars like Drew McIntyre.

stories.title: WWE star teases returning to previous character persona
stories.tldr: Johnny Gargano has spent months inactive and struggling with depression on WWE television following major setbacks like losing a feud and his tag partner moving to AEW. Fueling speculation of a character change, he recently marked the anniversary of his 2022 return with a cryptic social media post. This comes as a broader reminder that only a tiny fraction of Triple H's 2022 wave of rehires remain with the company today.

stories.title: Bayley and Blake Monroe exchange social media teases regarding WWE future
stories.tldr: Bayley and Blake Monroe have escalated their social media feud, with Monroe directly challenging Bayley to appear on this week's SmackDown. The interaction coincides with Bayley celebrating her tenth main roster anniversary and exchanging cryptic messages with Raw General Manager Adam Pearce. Meanwhile, frequent television mentions by Lyra Valkyria and backstage reports suggest WWE management expects the veteran star to return.

stories.title: Update on WWE main roster call-up plans and vignettes for Lola Vice
stories.tldr: Lola Vice's upcoming SmackDown arrival features newly filmed vignettes that are described as attention-grabbing and expected to begin airing in the coming weeks. Reports indicate she will land on the Friday night brand alongside her real-life boyfriend Damian Priest. Additional details have also emerged regarding her recent championship run in NXT and her final appearances in AAA.

stories.title: Natalya comments on Chelsea Green's injury and Solo Sikoa's babyface potential
stories.tldr: Natalya recently argued that Chelsea Green's broken orbital bone is a blessing in disguise, providing an organic storyline obstacle that keeps fans hooked during her interim championship reign. Green successfully convinced Nick Aldis to let her keep the title following an emotional promo, earning support from colleagues including her husband Matt Cardona. Additionally, Natalya predicted that Solo Sikoa is positioned to become WWE's next major babyface due to his evolving personality and growing fan connection.

stories.title: Jim Johnston criticized over comments regarding source of pro wrestling theme songs
stories.tldr: Legendary composer Jim Johnston recently sparked debate by arguing that using commercial licensed songs for wrestler entrance themes is a mistake. He believes pop or rock tracks distract fans by tying personal memories to the music instead of focusing entirely on the wrestler. Critics of his viewpoint note that many iconic wrestling moments have successfully relied on famous commercial tracks over the years.

stories.title: Backstage update on WWE's primary objectives for non-televised house shows
stories.tldr: WWE is pushing its roster to create viral social media moments during live events rather than sticking to traditional house show matches. This strategy is a key focus of the ongoing 2026 Summer Tour, which spans multiple continents and features unexpected wrestler pairings. Recent untelevised shows have highlighted this approach through unusual tag team combinations and comedic or aggressive segments involving top stars like CM Punk, Cody Rhodes, Kevin Owens, and Danhausen.

stories.title: Chelsea Green explains why on-screen pairing with Matt Cardona was inevitable
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green recently debuted a custom bedazzled face mask and has been making chaotic waves on SmackDown. In a new interview, she opened up about finally sharing an on-screen WWE segment with her real-life husband, Matt Cardona. Cardona recently returned to defend her from Gunther on television, which Green noted was an inevitable blending of their real and professional lives.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth becomes double champion at TNA Lockdown; Leon Slater invokes Option C for BFG
stories.tldr: At TNA Lockdown, Nic Nemeth became a double champion after he and his brother Ryan defeated The Hardys to win the TNA World Tag Team Championship, adding to his ongoing TNA World Championship reign. Earlier in the night, Leon Slater successfully defeated Cedric Alexander in a brutal Last Man Standing match to regain the X Division Championship. Immediately following the main event, Slater interrupted the Nemeths' celebration to exercise Option C, voluntarily relinquishing the X Division title to TNA President Carlos Silva. Slater then laid down the challenge to face Nic Nemeth for the TNA World Championship at Bound for Glory on October 11 in Tampa, Florida, standing tall over both Nemeth brothers to close the show.

stories.title: Kiera Hogan returns to TNA at Lockdown and wins Knockouts Tag Title with Allie
stories.tldr: Kiera Hogan made a surprise return to TNA at the Lockdown 2026 pay-per-view after a five-year absence. Stepping in as a replacement partner for the absent Rosemary, Hogan helped Allie defeat The Elegance Brand to capture the Knockouts World Tag Team Championships. TNA subsequently confirmed that Hogan has officially signed a new multi-year contract with the company.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown 2026 overall review and results
stories.tldr: TNA recently presented Lockdown 2026 in Chicago, marking the company's first all-cage pay-per-view in a decade. The event featured intense violence, multiple title changes, and dramatic moments including Mustafa Ali's cruel tactics against Jason Hotch and Xia Brookside retaining her championship in a brutal bout. The night culminated with X Division champion Leon Slater laying out the tag team champions and officially cashing in Option C to challenge for the world title at Bound for Glory.

stories.title: Leon Slater defeats Cedric Alexander to win TNA X-Division Title at Lockdown
stories.tldr: Leon Slater defeated Cedric Alexander in a brutal Last Man Standing steel cage match at TNA Lockdown to capture his second X-Division Championship. The high-stakes bout featured severe punishment, including Alexander driving Slater head-first into the cage and delivering an avalanche Michinoku Driver. Slater ultimately turned the tide by hitting three consecutive Lumbar Checks followed by a Swanton 450 to keep Alexander down for the ten-count. The victory not only secures Slater his second title reign but also preserves his historical accolades in TNA, as a loss would have erased his previous records from the history books.

stories.title: Matches set and added for upcoming TNA iMPACT episode
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has loaded up the card for the upcoming August 27 episode of iMPACT following events at TNA Lockdown. Two major matches have now been officially locked in for the broadcast, giving fans plenty of reasons to tune in. The updated lineup features a high-stakes championship final as well as an intriguing tag team encounter involving newly crowned gold.

stories.title: Lucha Libre veteran Solar II passes away at age 66
stories.tldr: Lucha libre veteran Solar II, whose real name was Pedro Buenrostro Gomez, has passed away at the age of 66 following recent health struggles. His brother, Solar I, confirmed the sad news in a heartfelt family statement remembering his life and career. Throughout a professional journey spanning over five decades beginning in 1975, he primarily competed for CMLL and captured the NWA World Welterweight Championship in 1988 before retiring in 2002. CMLL honored the late luchador with a moment of silence and applause at Arena Mexico following his passing on August 23.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling holds preliminary investment talks with RARESTNDRD
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling recently hosted high-profile entertainment and investment figures during the Lockdown 2026 pay-per-view in Chicago to discuss potential strategic partnerships. Nick LoPiccolo, founder of the new venture RARESTNDRD and former Paradigm Talent Agency head, attended the event alongside music executive Brandon Marquez and film producer Tarek Tohme. The preliminary discussions with TNA President Carlos Silva focused on raising capital and potential direct investment into the promotion. LoPiccolo publicly praised the company afterward, emphasizing that he views TNA as a serious growth enterprise rather than a nostalgia act.

stories.title: Matt Hardy reflects on fan support following TNA Lockdown 2026
stories.tldr: Matt Hardy shared a video showing a massive line of fans waiting to meet him and Jeff Hardy over two hours after TNA Lockdown 2026 concluded. Earlier in the night, the legendary tag team main evented the pay-per-view in a brutal steel cage match where they lost the TNA World Tag Team Championships to Nic and Ryan Nemeth. Despite the tough loss and the late hour, the Hardys spent hours signing autographs for a dedicated crowd in Chicago. The impressive turnout highlighted the enduring popularity and massive demand the duo still commands after decades in the wrestling industry.

stories.title: Steph De Lander sparks online debate after insulting biscuits and gravy
stories.tldr: Australian wrestler Steph De Lander sparked a lighthearted online debate after posting on Twitter that biscuits and gravy is an insane American meal. Her comments quickly drew sharp reactions from her peers, including a confused response from Mance Warner. Zachary Wentz strongly defended the Southern comfort food, telling De Lander not to trash the dish. The playful exchange showed just how seriously some wrestlers take their traditional breakfast plates.

stories.title: Elayna Black shows bloody aftermath of TNA Lockdown steel cage match
stories.tldr: Elayna Black failed to capture the Knockouts World Championship from Xia Brookside at TNA Lockdown 2026 after a brutal steel cage match in Chicago. Despite losing following interference and a roll-up, Black shared a graphic mirror selfie on Twitter revealing the extent of her bloody injuries. The controversial hometown loss sparked heavy boos from the live crowd, especially with Black's family watching cageside.

stories.title: DragonKingKarl explores unbroken match lineage from pioneer era
stories.tldr: Wrestling historian Karl Stern recently released a special podcast episode tracing an unbroken match lineage from the pioneer era of the 1800s to the modern rosters of WWE and AEW. The episode serves as both an accessible jumping-on point for new listeners and a thrilling deep dive for longtime fans of early pro wrestling history. By connecting historic figures like Col. James H. McLaughlin directly to contemporary superstars, the audio show argues that pioneer-era wrestling is the true ancestor of today's sports entertainment rather than mixed martial arts.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown 2026 fallout: New champions, returns, and news roundups
stories.tldr: TNA Lockdown 2026 delivered massive fallout featuring multiple new champions and high-profile returns. Mustafa Ali, Leon Slater, and The Nemeth Brothers all captured gold, while Kiera Hogan made her official return and signing with the company. Additionally, Avery Styles, the son of AJ Styles, officially signed with TNA, and the main event set up a blockbuster World Championship match for Bound for Glory.

stories.title: Jason Hotch coughs blood following wild spot at TNA Lockdown
stories.tldr: During a brutal TNA Lockdown match, Jason Hotch defended his TNA International Championship against Mustafa Ali in a chaotic steel cage encounter. The match featured a terrifying high-risk spot where Hotch crashed off the top of the cage and put Ali through a ringside table, resulting in Hotch coughing up blood and sparking fears of internal injuries. Despite the medical scare, Ali escalated the drama by taunting Hotch's family at ringside and destroying a toy belonging to Hotch's daughter. Ali ultimately capitalized on the carnage to secure the victory with back-to-back 450 splashes, though Hotch earned a standing ovation from the crowd for his courageous performance.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali regains TNA International Title at Lockdown in cage match
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali reclaimed the TNA International Championship by defeating his former Order 4 soldier Jason Hotch in a brutal steel cage match at TNA Lockdown. The hometown bout featured high-risk maneuvers, outside interference from Tasha Steelz and Mila Moore, and psychological warfare involving Hotch's family. Ali ultimately secured the victory and his second title reign after executing two consecutive 450 splashes.

stories.title: Xia Brookside retains TNA Knockouts World Championship at Lockdown
stories.tldr: Xia Brookside successfully defended her TNA Knockouts World Championship against Elayna Black in a brutal match at Lockdown. The champion resorted to underhanded tactics, including using a belt as a weapon and throwing chalk dust into her challenger's eyes to secure the winning pinfall. Meanwhile, Indi Hartwell watched the violent encounter closely from backstage, having already established herself as the next challenger for the title.

stories.title: WWE tryout attendees spotted backstage at TNA Lockdown
stories.tldr: Independent wrestlers J-Rod and Josh Bishop were spotted in attendance at the TNA Lockdown event in Chicago after recently participating in WWE tryouts earlier this month. Both athletes have drawn interest from TNA Wrestling over the past few months, and the promotion is reportedly considering contract offers if they do not sign with WWE. The wrestlers were strictly at the event as spectators and were not dressed to compete. Another independent wrestler, Pinky Montoya, was also spotted attending the show.

stories.title: Candice Michelle makes surprise appearance at TNA Lockdown
stories.tldr: Former WWE Women’s Champion Candice Michelle made a surprise cameo appearance during the Countdown to TNA Lockdown pre-show alongside Daria Rae, Matthew Rehwoldt, and Tom Hannifan. During her appearance, she previewed the Knockouts World Championship match between Xia Brookside and Elayna Black while discussing her backstage producer role with the company. Candice revealed she has been working with TNA since March and recently hinted at a potential in-ring return.

stories.title: Indie veteran Eric Draven reflects on 35-year wrestling career
stories.tldr: Independent wrestling veteran Eric Draven is reflecting on an impressive 35-year career that has spanned 48 states and featured matches against legendary opponents. Trained by wrestling greats like Jeff Jarrett and Rip Rogers, Draven developed his ring name from Jarrett's advice rather than the movie The Crow. Today, the Supreme Wrestling promoter and trainer balances his in-ring experience as an old-school brawler with passing his knowledge down to new talent. As he continues his decades-long journey, Draven remains motivated and active within the independent circuit.

stories.title: Matt Hardy discusses how he would guide his children entering pro wrestling
stories.tldr: TNA star Matt Hardy recently discussed on his podcast how he would approach his three sons potentially entering the professional wrestling business. While fans might love the idea of a second-generation Hardy Boyz team, Matt would take a cautious and calculated approach to their training and career development. He outlined plans to ensure they learn the ins and outs of the industry, start small in independent promotions, and network effectively while preparing for inevitable internet criticism.

stories.title: AJ Styles' son Avery Styles officially signs with TNA Wrestling at Lockdown
stories.tldr: Avery Styles officially signed with TNA Wrestling during the Lockdown pay-per-view event in Chicago. Entering to his father's theme music, the rookie announced his new contract live to the fans. He was immediately confronted and welcomed by Frankie Kazarian, who offered himself as a trustworthy mentor in the locker room.

stories.title: Joe Alonzo signs with TNA Wrestling following Lockdown dark match win
stories.tldr: Following Santino Marella's initial challenge, Joe Alonzo officially secured his TNA Wrestling contract at Lockdown. During the event, the AAW Heavyweight Champion defeated the masked Home Town Man in a dark match stipulation to cement his new status. Reports indicate that Alonzo's deal was actually finalized prior to the match following a series of impressive independent appearances.

stories.title: DREAM Pro Wrestling raises funds for Rebel's ALS fight
stories.tldr: DREAM Pro Wrestling recently raised over seven thousand dollars for Tanea Brooks, known as Rebel, following her ALS diagnosis earlier this year. The promotion held a special benefit show organized by Truth Magnum of The Outrunners to support her ongoing battle against the terminal illness. Additionally, AEW is stepping up its support by hosting a dedicated episode of Dynamite titled Rebel Heart in Athens, Georgia. The upcoming event highlights the continued solidarity from the wrestling community toward the former star.

stories.title: MVP Discusses Financial Advice and Timeline for Final Match
stories.tldr: AEW star MVP recently shared valuable financial wisdom he learned from fellow wrestlers like Jinder Mahal and WWE Hall of Famer Ricky Steamboat during his podcast Marking Out. At 52 years old, MVP also discussed his in-ring retirement timeline, revealing he plans to have his final match next year. He confirmed that his current AEW contract keeps him with the company through age 57, where he will continue managing The Hurt Syndicate as a mouthpiece and consultant.

stories.title: Chris Jericho Recalls Classic 2001 WWE Tag Team Match
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho recently reflected on the iconic May 2001 Raw tag team match where he and Chris Benoit defeated Steve Austin and Triple H for the WWE Tag Team Championships. While the match is widely celebrated as one of the best in Raw history, the backstage atmosphere quickly turned grim when the roster learned that Triple H had severely torn his quad. This unexpected injury completely derailed creative plans that originally featured a singles feud between Jericho and Triple H. Ultimately, the pivot led to Jericho and Benoit challenging Austin in a triple threat match at King of the Ring instead.

stories.title: AEW Announces Last-Minute Matches Before Collision
stories.tldr: AEW finalized the match card for the August 22 episode of Collision in Reading, Pennsylvania, less than an hour before the show went live. The last-minute additions include a trios match featuring The Hurt Syndicate alongside ROH Pure Champion Lee Moriarty and a five-minute women tag team title eliminator. These bouts join an already stacked lineup featuring a women world championship match and continental challenge cup quarterfinals.

stories.title: Kevin Knight Compares His Opportunities in AEW vs. NJPW
stories.tldr: Current TNT Champion Kevin Knight recently compared his time in New Japan Pro Wrestling to his current run in AEW during an interview on The Ringer. Knight explained that New Japan relies on a strict traditional system where wrestlers must progress slowly from Young Lions to graduation, whereas AEW acts as a land of opportunity without bureaucratic roadblocks keeping talent down. Having signed with AEW in March 2025 after nearly five years in New Japan, Knight noted he has accomplished more in one year in AEW than he did in five years abroad. He is now preparing to defend his TNT Championship against Darby Allin in a Falls Count Anywhere match at AEW All In in London on August 30.

stories.title: Sherilyn Guerrero Expresses Interest in Facing Mercedes Mone
stories.tldr: Sherilyn Guerrero, the daughter of WWE Hall of Famer Eddie Guerrero, is currently training to pursue a professional wrestling career. During a recent interview with MuscleManMalcolm, she expressed a strong desire to step into the ring with AEW star Mercedes Mone. Sherilyn highlighted Mone's extensive experience, technical chain wrestling skills, and well-known admiration for Eddie Guerrero as key reasons for wanting the match.

stories.title: Darby Allin Names Favorite In-Ring Opponents
stories.tldr: AEW star Darby Allin recently revealed his favorite in-ring opponents while receiving a chiropractic adjustment. He named Jon Moxley, Brody King, Max, and Sting as performers who share his fearless mindset and desire to push creative boundaries on national television. Brody King, who was present during the interview, echoed these sentiments by explaining how they actively reject standard industry tropes to create edgier television.

stories.title: TKO Representatives Spotted Attending Recent AEW Event
stories.tldr: Representatives from TKO were recently spotted in attendance at an AEW Dynamite event in Las Vegas. Reports indicate these officials purchased their own tickets to evaluate the competition firsthand rather than attending on complimentary passes. The event featured a stacked card including multiple Continental Challenge Cup matches and Casino Gauntlet qualifying action. The unexpected corporate scouting trip even drew a public reaction from AEW star Mercedes Mone on social media.

stories.title: Mick Foley Explains Learning How to Make Opponents Bleed
stories.tldr: Hardcore legend Mick Foley recently discussed his extensive history with bleeding in professional wrestling during a podcast appearance. He detailed his preference for bleeding the hard way, such as getting cuts on his eyebrows from targeted downward punches, rather than relying on traditional blades. Foley explained that this heightened level of realism was especially crucial in southern territories to ensure fans remained invested and returned every week.

stories.title: Nyla Rose Responds to Transphobic Comment from Fan
stories.tldr: Former AEW women’s champion Nyla Rose participated in the ALS ice bucket challenge to support Rebel, who was diagnosed with the disease in early 2026. A social media user responded to her video with a transphobic comment targeting her appearance. Rose fired back with a confident rebuttal and later explained that she addressed the troll to show that online harassment does not affect her.

stories.title: Match Lineup and Continental Challenge Cup Semifinals Set for AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Following the latest episode of Collision, a high-stakes singles match between Swerve Strickland and Jack Perry has been added to the upcoming AEW Dynamite in Glasgow. The Continental Challenge Cup semifinals are also locked in, featuring Kyle O'Reilly against Nigel McGuinness and a stablemate collision between Jon Moxley and Claudio Castagnoli. The semifinal matchups were determined after O'Reilly defeated Orange Cassidy and Castagnoli overcame Daniel Garcia, who had previously stepped in to replace the medically sidelined Eddie Kingston.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov Exits WWE as Free Agent; Tony Khan Addresses Interest
stories.tldr: Following his departure from WWE, free agent Ilja Dragunov is drawing heavy speculation regarding a move to AEW or potential European independent dates. AEW President Tony Khan recently addressed the rumors, praising Dragunov as a tremendous talent while remaining non-committal about current negotiations. Backstage reports have since clarified that his contract simply expired without a non-compete clause, fueling speculation that he could debut at upcoming major events like AEW All In.

stories.title: Paul Wight Criticizes Modern Locker Room Culture and Unwillingness to Lose
stories.tldr: Paul Wight recently expanded on his critique of locker room culture by calling out old-school bullying and arguing that modern talent is too soft. He noted that today's wrestlers are often just happy to be on TV as fans rather than maximizing their pay. Furthermore, Wight slammed wrestlers who refuse to lose scripted matches, arguing that the business has changed and performers are just actors playing a role.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor Results and Title Changes
stories.tldr: Beyond the TV title change, Death Before Dishonor featured several other major championship bouts and a dramatic World Title defense. Lethal Twist captured the ROH World Six-Man Tag Team Titles from Dalton Castle and The Outrunners, while champions like Bandido, Athena, and Red Velvet successfully retained their gold. In the main event, Bandido narrowly defeated 21-year-old challenger Nick Wayne, who blew his historic opportunity to become the youngest champion in company history due to cockiness on a pinfall attempt.

stories.title: Athena Suffers Asthma Attack During ROH Match
stories.tldr: Athena successfully defended her ROH Women's World Championship against Hazuki at Death Before Dishonor following outside interference. However, the champion revealed that she suffered a frightening asthma attack in the middle of the bout. She praised the medical and backstage staff for their quick response in helping her finish the match. Athena remains champion, pushing her historic reign past 1350 days.

stories.title: AEW Exploring Lower Production Costs for Future Video Games
stories.tldr: Following a costly thirty million dollar loss on their debut video game, AEW is evaluating how to approach future titles. Fortunately, the promotion retains ownership of the existing game engine, which will drastically reduce production costs for any future projects. While no new console game is currently locked in and their partnership with the original developer has ended, the company remains open to future gaming ventures using their proprietary technology.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Covers Death Before Dishonor and WWE Feuds
stories.tldr: Jim Valley reviewed the standout in-ring performances and press scrum notes from Friday's ROH Death Before Dishonor event. The latest audio update also covers a fresh WWE SmackDown episode featuring Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn, alongside backstage reactions to Blake Monroe. Additionally, the show previews upcoming action across AEW Collision, AAA, and CMLL while discussing talent updates for Hiromu Takahashi, Ilja Dragunov, and Giulia.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone Recalls Attending WWE WrestleMania in Disguise
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone recently revealed that she snuck into a WWE WrestleMania event in disguise to support her best friend, Bayley. While refusing to name the specific year she attended incognito, Mone expressed her fondness for hiding in plain sight to cheer on her longtime rival. She also reiterated that a future clash between the two remains a dream scenario, though they have not shared a ring since 2021.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone Praises AEW Women's Division
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone has expressed immense satisfaction with her current run in All Elite Wrestling while looking ahead to major events and discussing potential dream matches like facing Bayley. Expanding on her locker room experience, Mone is now praising the promotion's female roster as historic. She highlighted the intense drive, unique talents, and relentless work ethic of her peers. According to the star, this competitive environment ensures that everyone is constantly pushing to be the absolute best.

stories.title: Rumors Surface Regarding The New Day Appearing at AEW All In
stories.tldr: The AEW World Trios Championship picture for All In is taking shape following an open challenge from the reigning champions. A massive brawl on Dynamite has set up several participating teams, with additional groups also rumored for the bout. Most notably, reports indicate that former WWE stars Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are very likely to debut and team with Swerve Strickland for the event. Backstage talent is reportedly thrilled about the prospect, even though official contracts have not yet been finalized.

stories.title: Omos Suspended Indefinitely from AAA Following Rey Mysterio Attack
stories.tldr: Omos has been suspended indefinitely from Lucha Libre AAA following a violent rampage during the August 22, 2026 episode of AAA on FOX. After brutalizing Galeno and destroying the commentary desk, Omos confronted AAA General Manager Rey Mysterio and hoisted him up for a chokeslam. Although Dominik Mysterio encouraged the slam and Dorian Roldan opposed it, Omos ultimately spared Rey before receiving the indefinite suspension and subsequently punching Rey out of the ring. This sudden fallout throws a major wrench into Dominik Mysterio's plans, as Omos was expected to back his title defense at TripleMania.

stories.title: Matt Cardona Discusses Dream Opponent and WWE Unreal Appearance
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently named WWE Hall of Famer Macho Man Randy Savage as his ultimate dream opponent across any era or character iteration. Cardona also reflected on his current involvement in Netflix's docuseries WWE Unreal, noting how frustrating it was to be barred from appearing during the show's first season while living with his wife, Chelsea Green. Additionally, Cardona recently made waves on SmackDown by confronting GUNTHER to defend his wife's honor.

stories.title: Becky Lynch and Finn Balor Discuss Favorite Opponents and WrestleMania Main Event
stories.tldr: Irish WWE stars Becky Lynch and Finn Balor recently reflected on their storied careers during joint media appearances, naming their all-time favorite in-ring opponents. Lynch highlighted Bianca Belair and Asuka, while Balor selected Samoa Joe and GUNTHER. Balor also emotionaly recalled training a 15-year-old Lynch and watching her rise to headline the first-ever women's WrestleMania main event. Lynch expressed deep gratitude for Balor's early mentorship and discussed the collective vision she and the Four Horsewomen shared to shatter glass ceilings in professional wrestling.

stories.title: Bayley Reflects on 10 Years in Women's Wrestling
stories.tldr: Bayley recently celebrated the ten-year anniversary of her WWE main roster debut with a reflective social media post emphasizing her ongoing dedication to women's wrestling. However, this milestone coincides with heavy speculation about her future as her current WWE contract is reportedly expiring later this year. Following an angle where she was seemingly written off television by Lyra Valkyria, both Bayley and former tag partner Mercedes Mone have dropped intriguing hints on social media. These teases, including a training video set to a fittingly titled track, have fueled rumors that she could be heading toward AEW.

stories.title: WWE Seeking to Generate More Viral Moments at Live Events
stories.tldr: WWE is actively encouraging its talent to generate viral social media moments during live events rather than just wrestling standard house show matches. Wrestlers are now staging tension-filled interactions, targeted promos, and unexpected attacks that fans are eager to record and share online. Recent examples of this new directive include physical altercations between top stars, aggressive family-targeted promos, and sudden betrayals. This strategy capitalizes on the reality that every fan in attendance now has a camera in their pocket, turning routine live shows into breeding grounds for online discussion.

stories.title: Natalya Recalls Vince McMahon and Hart Family Animosity
stories.tldr: Natalya recently discussed the intense historical animosity between Vince McMahon and the Hart family that stemmed from the 1997 Montreal Screwjob. Despite Bret Hart physically assaulting McMahon and family members being barred from backstage areas, Natalya eventually earned a WWE contract after five years of relentless effort. She noted that her initial struggles to get hired were ultimately due to not fitting what the company was looking for at the time rather than the family feud.

stories.title: Sol Ruca Recalls Scary Fall During NXT Run
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT star Sol Ruca recently reflected on a terrifying botched spot during her Last Woman Standing match against Zaria before transitioning to the main roster. During the climax of the bout, Ruca was supposed to go through two tables from an elevated platform but instead hit only one, violently striking the back of her head on the second. Despite splitting her head open and initially believing she was completely fine due to adrenaline, medical personnel quickly rushed to her aid during the live broadcast. Ruca ultimately missed 20 days of action before making a successful return on Raw against IYO SKY, narrowly avoiding a career-altering injury.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Expresses Interest in Bringing Back Divas Championship
stories.tldr: WWE star Blake Monroe recently expressed her desire to bring back the historic Divas Championship, noting that the butterfly belt would match her outfits. During an interview, Monroe also named WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus as her dream opponent from a previous era, praising her as the ultimate diva. This comes as other modern wrestlers, including Charlotte Flair, have similarly attempted to reclaim the term diva and reframe the legacy of that era of women's wrestling.

stories.title: WON Flashback Looks Back at WWF SummerSlam 1999
stories.tldr: A recent flashback looked back at WWF SummerSlam 1999, held on August 22 at the Minneapolis Target Center, which featured five title changes and massive commercial success. While the event drew a sellout crowd and high pay-per-view expectations, it also hosted a notoriously terrible Women Championship match between Ivory and Tori. Dave Meltzer's original newsletter review highlighted everything from the financial figures and the surprisingly great Shane McMahon versus Test match to the infamous negative two-star women match and its bizarre post-angle crowd reaction.

stories.title: WWE Stars Expected to Join New Paul Heyman Faction
stories.tldr: Paul Heyman has grown increasingly detached from his current group on Raw, sparking speculation that the veteran advocate is preparing to form a brand new faction. Recent programming hints and character shifts suggest several major WWE stars could soon align themselves with Heyman. Potential recruits range from main eventers like Cody Rhodes and rising powerhouses to underutilized talent seeking a creative spark.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans Names Classic WWE Belts He Wants to Bring Back
stories.tldr: Rising WWE star Je'Von Evans recently discussed his desire to revive iconic championship designs if he captures gold in the company. During a recent interview, the twenty-two-year-old expressed fondness for the famous John Cena spinner belt and even referenced holding one during a recent entrance. Evans specifically stated that if he breaks Randy Orton's record to become the youngest WWE world champion, he intends to bring back the prestigious Big Gold Belt.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair Reflects on Standout NXT Match
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair recently reflected on her pivotal 2014 NXT TakeOver match against Natalya, considering it the true turning point of her career. She admitted she feels she was not taken seriously as a competitor before this historic bout, which allowed her to step out of the shadow of legends Ric Flair and Bret Hart. Flair also counts her WrestleMania 34 match against Asuka as another major defining moment that shaped her legendary path in the industry.

stories.title: JBL Suggests Acting Coaches Would Benefit Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently expressed support for the idea of professional wrestling companies utilizing dedicated acting coaches to help talent improve their pre-tapes and backstage segments, admitting that some current skits can be cringeworthy due to overacting or underacting. During a discussion on the Something to Wrestle podcast with Conrad Thompson, JBL noted that while wrestling historically resisted outside influences and pretended not to be scripted, professional instruction would help performers create the crucial perception of authenticity. Former WWE star Jinder Mahal later responded on social media to agree with the sentiment, while clarifying that WWE actually already offers such resources for talents who choose to ask for them.

stories.title: Ticket Sales Updates for Upcoming WWE Events
stories.tldr: Recent ticket sales data for upcoming World Wrestling Entertainment events spanning from late August through November 2026 has been revealed. The numbers highlight strong demand across various live shows, television tapings, and major premium live events like Survivor Series and Money In The Bank. Notable figures include massive draws for international and domestic stadium shows, as well as joint or partnered events involving promotions like AAA.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Prepares Bedazzled Mask for Broken Orbital Bone
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green has officially revealed her fully customized, bedazzled protective face mask and matching eye patches featuring her CG logo. She recently appeared on SmackDown to fend off Nia Jax and Lash Legend with a kendo stick, while also opening up about sharing a WWE ring with her real-life husband Matt Cardona. Green is currently working against a 30-day countdown given by Nick Aldis to get medically cleared and defend her championship.

stories.title: Lil Yachty Training with Raw Star Ahead of WWE In-Ring Debut
stories.tldr: Lil Yachty is set to make his official WWE in-ring debut against Baron Corbin at Sunday Night's Main Event in a five-minute survival match that could earn Trick Williams a title shot. Reports indicate that the rapper has been quietly training for months at the Performance Center with Raw star Ivy Nile and is expected to work with the company for the foreseeable future. Triple H has publicly hyped the upcoming clash, which will also feature marquee matches like Cody Rhodes versus Randy Orton.

stories.title: Blake Monroe and Bayley Exchange Words After Cancelled SmackDown Match
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe avoided her official in-ring debut by ambushing Giulia on SmackDown, insisting she is instead focused on the world championship. Following the incident, Monroe and Giulia traded barbs on social media over the aborted match. Monroe has now also engaged in a tense Twitter exchange with Bayley, challenging the absent star to show up on SmackDown or stop tweeting her. Meanwhile, Monroe has made it clear she wants a direct path to the champion, Chelsea Green.

stories.title: Awesome Kong Opens Up About WWE Release and Kharma Ring Name
stories.tldr: Awesome Kong returned to WWE at the 2012 Royal Rumble shortly after suffering the tragic stillbirth of her son, but her second run was quickly derailed by backstage conflicts. She clashed with management after refusing to play what she considered backstage mind games when they rejected her preferred methods for getting back into wrestling shape. Kong also revealed that the Kong name was originally assigned to her in Japan without her consent, and her WWE persona, Kharma, was ultimately meant to represent taking back her voice.

stories.title: Nikki Bella Responds to 'Backstabber Bella' Remarks in Feud with Paige
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella and Paige are continuing their simmering feud primarily through digital platforms after a planned television promo was recently cut. Following a social media back-and-forth where Paige questioned Nikki's absence from SmackDown, Nikki fired back at being labeled a backstabber. Nikki addressed the remark while enjoying a spa day, sarcastically congratulating Paige on finally getting television time.

stories.title: WWE Stars Who Previously Faced Hiromu Takahashi (Kyoki)
stories.tldr: Following his recent SmackDown debut as Kyoki alongside Shinsuke Nakamura, the former New Japan star's extensive history with several current WWE roster members has come to light. Kyoki previously crossed paths with Tama Tonga, whom he and Nakamura are currently targeting in the tag team division. Other notable current WWE stars who have past matches with Kyoki include Penta, Rey Fenix, Naraku, Finn Balor, and Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Planning Upcoming Babyface Turns
stories.tldr: Following recent successful face transitions for stars like Becky Lynch and Chad Gable, WWE is reportedly lining up several more potential babyface turns. Names on the radar include Bloodline enforcer Jacob Fatu, Judgment Day member Roxanne Perez, returning star Rusev, and Chad Gable's former stablemates in American Made. These potential shifts could significantly alter the roster dynamics in the coming months.

stories.title: WWE Planning Refresh for Raw and SmackDown Tag Team Divisions
stories.tldr: WWE is actively revamping its tag team divisions across both brands following a wave of roster shifts and planned title unifications. New contenders are stepping up to challenge current champions as creative directions solidify. Several prominent duos are receiving increased television focus, while other expected challengers remain out of the immediate title picture.

stories.title: Potential Matches Discussed for WWE Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: Creative discussions have highlighted several potential matches being lined up for the upcoming October event. Plans reportedly point toward a triple threat for the Undisputed WWE Championship and a United States title rematch between Baron Corbin and Trick Williams. Additionally, personal feuds are expected to culminate with a singles clash between Paige and Nikki Bella and a steel cage blow-off match between Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton.

stories.title: Backstage Update on Bayley's WWE Contract and Status
stories.tldr: Bayley's expiring WWE contract and prolonged television absence have fueled speculation about her future with the company. Despite these rumors and ongoing contract uncertainty, television storylines continue to reference her absence. Furthermore, a recent training video shared with Mercedes Mone has reportedly caused some backstage friction within WWE as talks continue.

stories.title: WWE Announces Updated Lineup for Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Lil Yachty is set to make his official WWE in-ring debut at Sunday Night's Main Event following his recent attack on United States Champion Baron Corbin. It has now been revealed that Yachty will face Corbin in a non-title match with a unique stipulation where lasting five minutes earns Trick Williams a title shot. The high-profile card also features Oba Femi battling Bron Breakker and Cody Rhodes squaring off against Randy Orton. The special event broadcasts live on Peacock from Atlanta on September 6.

stories.title: AAA Ola de Calor Match Announcements and Card Updates
stories.tldr: Lucha Libre AAA has finalized several major match announcements and card updates for the upcoming Ola de Calor event on August 30, 2026, at the Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas. Following fallout from the August 22 episode of AAA on FOX, General Manager Rey Mysterio booked a blockbuster six-man tag match, a four-way Latin American title bout, a tag team title match, and a Reina de Reinas number-one contender gauntlet. The event will also feature a contract signing between Dominik Mysterio and El Grande Americano, alongside the in-ring debut of El Carnicero.

stories.title: AJ Styles' Son Avery Styles Set for TNA Debut at Lockdown
stories.tldr: Avery Styles, the son of wrestling legend AJ Styles, is officially scheduled to appear at TNA Wrestling's upcoming Lockdown pay-per-view event in Chicago. Having made his professional wrestling debut in June and subsequently wrestling for promotions like GCW, Avery's exact role at the event remains unconfirmed by the promotion. TNA has not yet announced whether he will step into the ring to compete or simply make a special appearance on the show. This high-profile booking connects the rookie to his father's former home promotion during a time when a working relationship exists between TNA and WWE.

stories.title: Santino Marella Reflects on Dusty Rhodes Lesson and Joining TNA
stories.tldr: Santino Marella recently appeared on a podcast hosted by Cody Rhodes to discuss his storied wrestling career and current role in TNA. He shared a life-changing lesson from Dusty Rhodes about always saying yes to new opportunities, which helped him bluff his way into his iconic Italian WWE gimmick. Marella also explained how he eventually joined TNA as their Director of Authority after previously turning down offers due to managing his wrestling school and supporting his daughter's WWE career. Today, he has fallen back in love with the business through coaching, producing, and navigating the modern wrestling landscape.

stories.title: AAW Title Match Added to TNA Lockdown
stories.tldr: TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella appeared at AAW Unbreakable to announce a high-stakes crossover championship match for the upcoming TNA Lockdown event. AAW Heavyweight Champion Joe Alonzo will put his title on the line against TNA Superstar The Home Town Man on August 23, 2026, at the Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago. Marella added an extra incentive for the champion, promising Alonzo a coveted TNA contract if he successfully defends his title. This marquee addition brings the official TNA Lockdown match card to a stacked total of eleven bouts.

stories.title: Gabe Silva Defeats Kimbo Slice Jr. in Boxing Match
stories.tldr: Gabe Silva secured a second-round TKO victory over Kimbo Slice Jr. at Brand Risk Promotions 15 in a professional boxing match. After surviving a tough first round where he was rocked by his opponent, Silva rallied to drop Kimbo Jr. with an uppercut before finishing him with a left hook. Following the bout, Silva expressed mutual respect regarding the burden of carrying a famous combat sports legacy. In response to the defeat, Kimbo Jr. immediately challenged Silva to a rematch inside the MMA cage.

stories.title: Santino Marella Announces Major Match Stakes for TNA Lockdown
stories.tldr: TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella made a surprise appearance at AAW Unbreakable to announce a high-stakes match for the upcoming TNA Lockdown event in Chicago. AAW Heavyweight Champion Joe Alonzo will put his title on the line against a mystery TNA star who is also from Chicago, known as The Hometown Man. If Alonzo loses, his opponent wins the AAW Championship, but if Alonzo emerges victorious, he will earn a coveted TNA contract.

stories.title: Former Professional Wrestler 'Handsome' John Anson Passes Away at 77
stories.tldr: Former professional wrestler Handsome John Anson, also known as Karl von Schotz, has passed away at the age of 77 in the Dominican Republic. Born in Vancouver, Anson debuted in Stampede Wrestling at age 17 and became a two-time North American Champion in 1976. He captured numerous tag team titles throughout his career before retiring at the age of 35.

stories.title: Start Time Announced for AAA on FOX
stories.tldr: AAA on FOX broadcasts live tonight from the Coliseo Centenario in Torreón, Coahuila, Mexico, starting at 10pm Eastern. The stacked card features three confirmed matches, including Galeno versus Omos and a high-stakes bout where Penta must join Los Perros Del Mal if he loses to Bronco Nima. Fans can also look forward to a AAA Tag Team Championships number one contenders match involving the Psycho Circus, LWO, Los Americanos, and Money Machine. Global start times have been released for wrestling fans tuning in from around the world.

stories.title: Chris Bey Thanks CM Punk for Support During Injury Recovery
stories.tldr: TNA star Chris Bey has opened up about his close friendship with WWE star CM Punk, who has offered consistent support following Bey's severe neck injury in 2024. Bey noted that Punk frequently checks in on his recovery progress and offered help whenever needed. The two recently hit the gym together as part of their mutual dedication to achieving peak physical condition following Punk's recent world title victory. Punk even famously referenced Bey during a Monday Night Raw promo shortly after the TNA wrestler's devastating injury.

stories.title: Travis Meadows Prepares for In-Ring Comeback
stories.tldr: Travis Meadows, a wrestler from Uniontown, Pennsylvania who worked with Ryse Wrestling alongside his brother Bryan, recently underwent a successful life-saving liver transplant after a terrifying medical ordeal in 2025. Following months of severe illness, weight gain caused by toxic bile, and an emotional toll on his family, Meadows received a compatible liver from Kentucky on October 11th, 2025. Drawing inspiration from their childhood love of WCW, the Meadows brothers are channeling their resilient spirit into Travis's remarkable journey of recovery and an eventual in-ring comeback.

stories.title: Bronco Nima Kicked Out of Perros del Mal on AAA on FOX
stories.tldr: Bronco Nima was officially ousted from Perros del Mal following a high-stakes match on AAA on Fox where he failed to defeat Penta. After the match, despite an attempted recruitment of Penta, the faction brutally turned on Nima with steel chairs and a finisher from Karmen Petrovic. Penta ultimately rejected the group, leading to a massive brawl and setting up a major match for the upcoming Ola de Calor event.

stories.title: Rosemary Expected to Miss Significant Time Due to Injury
stories.tldr: TNA Lockdown features major card updates, including a Last Man Standing match and a mystery partner stepping in for the absent Rosemary. It has now been revealed that Rosemary is sidelined for a significant amount of time due to an injury suffered at a recent Firestar Pro Wrestling event. The exact nature of the injury remains undisclosed, leaving her return timeline completely uncertain. TNA must now figure out how to manage the Knockouts World Tag Team Championship picture without one-half of the reigning team for the foreseeable future.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Title Changes on August 22nd
stories.tldr: Moving past yesterday's historic events, August 22 boasts its own massive legacy with 286 notable pro wrestling title changes. Historic dates include SummerSlam 1999 where Mankind captured the WWF Championship and multiple other titles changed hands in a single night. Later years featured milestone moments across WWE and NXT, highlighted by champions like Bayley, Samoa Joe, and Noam Dar etching their names in history.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné addresses potential dream match vs. Bayley and happiness in AEW
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone recently discussed her creative freedom and happiness on the AEW roster while preparing for major events like All In at Wembley Stadium. During a recent interview, she also addressed the possibility of facing her longtime friend and rival Bayley in a future dream match. While Bayley is currently under a WWE contract that has sparked departure speculation, industry experts note that WWE continues to mention her on television, suggesting they expect her to return. Regardless of future contract statuses, Mone made it clear that sharing the ring with Bayley again remains a high priority on her wish list.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland mourns the loss of his original pro wrestling trainer
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland is mourning the passing of his original pro wrestling trainer, Ron The Pharaoh Cromartie. Cromartie was a prominent wrestler, promoter, and trainer on the Virginia independent scene who helped launch Strickland's career at the Ground Xero Wrestling Academy. Tributes have poured in from Strickland and local promotions recognizing Cromartie's legacy following his death. Meanwhile, Strickland is currently preparing for upcoming matches in AEW as he sets his sights on the Trios division.

stories.title: Karl Anderson says AJ Styles could 100% return to wrestling in AEW or elsewhere
stories.tldr: Former WWE star AJ Styles retired from in-ring competition in January 2026 and currently works in non-wrestling roles at NXT and the WWE Performance Center. In a recent interview, his longtime friend and Good Brothers tag team partner Karl Anderson expressed surprise at the retirement, noting that Styles can still perform at an elite level. Anderson stated that Styles could one day come out of retirement to wrestle in AEW or another promotion, pointing out his exceptional physical shape. While Styles himself previously left the door open for one special match, his actual return to the ring remains uncertain.

stories.title: Adam Copeland credits AEW for keeping him from retiring
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently revealed that he would be retired today if All Elite Wrestling did not exist, noting that his WWE career had reached its natural conclusion. After consulting his daughters and Tony Khan, Copeland made the jump to AEW in October 2023 to have fun, work with fresh talent, and reunite with Christian Cage. He credits the promotion with breathing new life into his career and providing exciting creative opportunities that keep his passion for wrestling alive.

stories.title: AEW champion addresses girlfriend's wrestling future following free agency
stories.tldr: AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight recently addressed the wrestling future of his real-life girlfriend, Mara Sadè, who became a free agent following her departure from TNA Wrestling in August. While keeping mum on whether she is headed to AEW, Knight praised her relentless work ethic and rapid improvement since her time in NXT. He also noted how their contrasting training backgrounds, from the New Japan Dojo to the WWE Performance Center, have allowed them to continuously share knowledge and sharpen each other's skills.

stories.title: Daniel Garcia wins at ROH Death Before Dishonor to enter AEW Continental Cup, replacing injured Eddie Kingston
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has been pulled from the AEW Continental Challenge Cup after failing to receive medical clearance for his quarterfinal match. To fill the vacancy, Daniel Garcia defeated Adam Priest in a play-in match at ROH Death Before Dishonor. Garcia now advances to face his Death Riders stablemate Claudio Castagnoli on the upcoming episode of AEW Collision.

stories.title: Action Andretti joins stable and wins ROH World TV Title at Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Action Andretti captured the ROH World Television Championship at Death Before Dishonor by defeating Lio Rush in a brutal Fight Without Honor match. During the chaotic bout, Andretti aligned with The Opps as HOOK and Anthony Bowens interfered to secure the title change. Following the match, a defeated Rush drank a mysterious black liquid from a heart-shaped container.

stories.title: David Arquette expresses interest in returning to wrestling with AEW
stories.tldr: David Arquette recently discussed his desire to produce a sequel to his 2000 wrestling comedy Ready to Rumble during a Reddit AMA. While financing remains a hurdle due to the original film's poor box office performance, the actor also revealed an interest in stepping back into the squared circle with AEW. Arquette specifically named Jeff Jarrett, Jack Perry, RJ City, and Dalton Castle as talent he would like to work with if an opportunity arises.

stories.title: Dax Harwood praises The Young Bucks and Mark Davis' future potential
stories.tldr: Dax Harwood recently praised The Young Bucks as potentially the greatest tag team of all time while discussing FTR's storied rivalry and legacy. Expanding on his recent media appearances, Harwood also reflected on his 2022 match against Aussie Open, correctly predicting that Mark Davis would eventually connect massively with fans despite Kyle Fletcher getting initial attention. Furthermore, Harwood labeled Davis one of the most underrated performers in the world and stated he would book him as a World Champion if he ran his own promotion.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor post-show media scrum and event notes
stories.tldr: Following the recent pay-per-view event, Ring of Honor hosted its post-show media scrum to address the night's developments. At the same time, critical analysis has highlighted ongoing questions regarding the brand's identity and long-term direction under Tony Khan. Observers continue to debate whether the promotion functions as a true developmental territory or merely a content mill for AEW.

stories.title: Road Dogg responds to claims political beliefs kept him out of AEW
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer has responded to recent claims that political beliefs cost a wrestling veteran a job with All Elite Wrestling. Meltzer pushed back on the allegation, stating that numerous employees within the company hold conservative viewpoints and that hiring decisions are never based on politics. The public back and forth originally stemmed from a disagreement over whether the promotion's tag team titles were beneath certain wrestlers.

stories.title: Athena retains Women's World Title against Hazuki at ROH Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Athena successfully defended her ROH Women's World Championship against STARDOM star Hazuki in the main event of Death Before Dishonor. Despite outside interference from Billie Starkz and Diamante on behalf of the champion, Hazuki fought them off before ultimately falling to Athena's signature O-Face. This marks the historic titleholder's 38th successful defense of the belt she has held since December 2022.

stories.title: Lethal Twist wins ROH Six-Man Tag Team Titles at Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Following earlier card adjustments, Death Before Dishonor continued with high-stakes championship action. In the opening match, Lethal Twist defeated Dalton Castle and The Outrunners to capture the ROH Six-Man Tag Team Titles. The victory ends the previous champions' 97-day reign and marks Jay Lethal's fifth distinct championship held within the promotion.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses AEW heel turn and free agency
stories.tldr: Following his shocking heel turn and pyro attack on Darby Allin, Kevin Knight is embracing his new persona as he prepares to face Allin at AEW All In: London. In a recent interview, Knight discussed how the heel run lets him finally showcase his authentic personality after years of suppressing it in structured systems like the New Japan dojo. He also named Jeff Hardy, The Rock, and Mr. Perfect as his childhood inspirations, and addressed the free agency of his partner, former TNA wrestler Mara Sadè.

stories.title: The Fight Game Podcast: Kenny Omega vs. Will Ospreay feud heats up
stories.tldr: The heated rivalry between Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay has intensified following provocative remarks made during their recent sit-down interview. Commentary on the latest edition of the Fight Game Podcast explores this escalating feud alongside other major pro wrestling storylines. Additional industry talking points include Solo Sikoa disrupting Bloodline business, the future trajectory of Ilja Dragunov, and a retrospective look at Missy Hyatt. This comes as AEW supports its broader programming with peripheral digital content including character-focused interviews and recovery documentaries.

stories.title: CM Punk retains WWE Title vs. Kevin Owens as Sami Zayn turns/interferes on SmackDown
stories.tldr: CM Punk successfully defended his Undisputed WWE Championship against Kevin Owens in a hard-fought main event on SmackDown in Toronto. The decisive moment came when Sami Zayn shockingly interfered, ultimately smashing Owens with the championship belt and allowing Punk to secure the pinfall. Frustrated over missing out on title opportunities since losing the belt earlier this summer, Zayn unleashed a post-match beatdown on both men. The chaotic turn firmly inserts Zayn into the championship picture as a vengeful wildcard while leaving Owens and Punk's brief program in the rearview.
